definitions.explanation: Appearing physically or emotionally weak, delicate, or fragile.

examples.japanese: {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: I answered in a feeble voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弱々|よわよわ}しく⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: After his illness, he looked frail.

examples.japanese: {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいた→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: A faint light was streaming in through the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{足取|あしど}り→足取り：10625_ashidori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だった。
examples.english: I was worried about my grandmother's frail steps.

notes:
An emphatic form of ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ created by reduplication ({弱|よわ} + {弱|よわ} + しい). Emphasizes the appearance or impression of weakness rather than actual weakness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ — a feeble voice
- {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ — a faint light
- {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{足取|あしど}り→足取り：10625_ashidori⟧ — frail footsteps
- {弱々|よわよわ}しい⟦{笑|え}み→笑み：13768_emi⟧ — a weak smile
- {弱々|よわよわ}しく⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ — to look frail

FORMS:
This follows the common Japanese pattern of reduplicating an adjective stem to create a しい-adjective that emphasizes appearance or impression:
- ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ → {弱々|よわよわ}しい (weak-looking)
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ → ⟦{痛々|いたいた}しい→痛々しい：08221_itaitashii⟧ (painful-looking, pitiful)
- ⟦{初々|ういうい}しい→初々しい：10595_uiuishii⟧ (fresh, innocent-looking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ — weak (direct, objective)
- ⟦{華奢|きゃしゃ}→華奢：09070_kyasha⟧ — delicate, slender (can be positive)
- ⟦{頼|たよ}りない→頼りない：14635_tayorinai⟧ — unreliable, flimsy
